additional_info.subject: RE: ID0451791-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P5 170000510] Outlet 3 Converter Errors CRM:03055000007
additional_info.body:
Dear RC-FR,
I have checked this charger and I can see there is a problem on DC3:
To understand which converter is the issue on:
As is on DC3, it is either on TB4 or TB13.
Please check which converter is not on the list below. That is the converter bring flagged.
To troubleshoot the issue:
Disconnect and connect the CAN cable. Check if problem is solved.
If not, switch the flagged converter with another converter.
If the error move to the new position of the convert -> Replace the converter.
If the problem stays on the original place -> Please replace the CAN cable.
I am sending this ticket to your queue for the onsite activities to be performed.
Please let me know if you have any question.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Laura Martins,
Please do not change the subject of this email when replying to it.
